messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Sat, Feb 03, 2024, Joel Gallardo via AMBER wrote:
>
>
>I have been having trouble installing as a non super user. do you think
>you can help me out with some instructions on how to install as non super
>user? i cant access as super user because i have an account on a computer
>that is not mine but i was given permission to install the program without
>installation of any system libraries under my account.
Nothing in Amber installation should require superuser privileges. You can
generally install required libraries into you PATH (rather than into
/usr/bin), but details depend on what OS you are using.
Please provide information about exactly what you tried, and what errors you
are seeing.
....dac
